title: basement underneath the school
content: multiple times i’ve now noticed that if i go to the school basement they had a laboratory where they would conduct human experiments. primarily on children is it just me who seen this? also has anyone else had the sky turn black and voice start messing with you while you’re in the dream it’s the scariest thing ive come to witness its unnatural. the voice mocked me a few times saying they’d bring back the sun but would take it back and the sky would become a void, most times natural disasters followed shortly after.
